how_to_replay.env: which payout destinations can receive (pay or park), and the maker's open_pending before a lock or take. On Ethereum the treasury share only increments treasuryAccrued: it is listed as paid to `treasury`.
how_to_replay.error: the chain's error name. A call refused only because of the time is TooLate if one of its windows in that state has already closed, else TooEarly. Check order: direction, caller, state and open hash, time, then secret or evidence.
how_to_replay.payouts: `parked: false` was transferred; `parked: true` stayed in escrow and was added to owed_*. A payout of zero is absent.
how_to_replay.row: Start from no swap. Run `open` (lock or take) by the taker wallet at `open.at`, then each `setup` step at its `at`, check the swap equals `from`, then run `step` at `step.at` and compare with `step.expect`.
how_to_replay.sequence: Start the maker record at `initial_maker`. Run every step at its `at`. A step with `expect.ok == false` must fail with `expect.error` and change nothing.
